dedupe_keys.name: wpuq german house and heat pump load profiles

description: WPuQ publishes electrical and heat-pump load profiles from German single-family homes, with weather and nearby district-heating temperature context. The Scientific Data article describes annual HDF5 files with aggregations from ten seconds to one hour. Zenodo lists the measurement and weather packages and states CC BY 4.0. These series can calibrate household heating demand or distribution-grid simulations under heat-pump uptake. Participating homes and devices are a limited sample, and measured demand reflects local controls, building envelopes and occupants, not all German households. Annual files and temporal resolutions must be matched before joining channels. I read own repository metadata and article data descriptions without downloading the large time-series archives. Related processing code is reviewed separately on GitHub. No exact catalogue record was found.
